guardrails: No secrets in repository content or logs
Human approval required before production-impacting deploy, policy, legal, or operational changes
All agents emit structured logs with task_id, result, failure_mode, and next_step
Core GitHub Pages deployment must not depend on paid services or optional external secrets

agents.name: Intake Agent
agents.purpose: Receive tasks, classify intent, urgency, affected systems, and route work.

agents.name: Planner Agent
agents.purpose: Break approved tasks into reversible execution plans with test gates.

agents.name: Executor Agent
agents.purpose: Perform approved repo, build, content, and deployment actions using least privilege.

agents.name: Auditor Agent
agents.purpose: Check security, links, accessibility, SEO, assets, and workflow health.

agents.name: Logger Agent
agents.purpose: Record actions, failures, evidence, and next steps in structured operational reports.

agents.name: Deployment Agent
agents.purpose: Validate GitHub Pages readiness, artifact creation, rollback notes, and deployment summaries.

agents.name: Marketing Agent
agents.purpose: Prepare safe website, product, offer, blog, and social content without unsupported claims.

agents.name: Revenue Agent
agents.purpose: Identify conversion paths, CTAs, lead capture logic, and product link continuity.

agents.name: Compliance Agent
agents.purpose: Review privacy, legal, employment, public-sector, and operational-risk language.

agents.name: Monitoring Agent
agents.purpose: Check workflow status, validation output, deploy health, and report failures clearly.
